gaps.term: cancellation along a route through the network
gaps.quote: each intermediate operator is followed by its inverse, so only the operators at the two endpoints remain
gaps.note: The page asserts that every intermediate operator on a route is followed by its inverse, so the product collapses to the endpoint operators. The page does not say what the operators on a route are or why each is followed by its inverse; that is a property of the network's wiring, which this page does not state. The cancellation itself is only the associativity of composition and T T^{-1} = id, which the reader can check once the wiring is given.
